review-01.author: Ananya S.
review-01.title: Finally a kitchen clean out
review-01.body: The kitchen degreaser cuts through months of cooking grease on the stovetop and chimney in one pass. Smells fresh, not perfumed.

review-02.author: Rohit M.
review-02.title: A little goes a long way
review-02.body: The dishwashing liquid has been in the kitchen for the last one and a half months. Very less quantity is required, and it cleans exceptionally.

review-03.author: Priya K.
review-03.title: Safe around the little one
review-03.body: I was worried about chemicals around my toddler. This bath & surface clean works just as well and I don't have to hide the bottle.

review-04.author: Meera D.
review-04.title: Floors smell amazing
review-04.body: The floor cleaner with geranium and lavender leaves the house smelling clean and the floors don't feel sticky afterwards.

review-05.author: Arjun P.
review-05.title: Hard water tap for years, gone
review-05.body: Years of hard-water marks on our taps dissolved within minutes, with no scrubbing and no damage to the chrome.

review-06.author: Sana F.
review-06.title: The laundry is brighter
review-06.body: No harsh fragrance, no residue. Whites are actually getting whiter with the laundry detergent, which surprised me.

review-07.author: Karthik V.
review-07.title: Handwash doesn't dry my hands
review-07.body: Works for my dry, sensitive skin. Keeps the hands soft but still gets the grime off.

review-08.author: Nandini R.
review-08.title: No more bleach smell
review-08.body: The bathroom cleaner removes water spots and soap scum without the harsh smell that used to linger all day.

review-09.author: Deepak T.
review-09.title: Fabric softener is gentle on skin
review-09.body: Clothes come out silky soft and barely fragranced with geranium and lavender. No itching, even for my wife's sensitive skin.

review-10.author: Sneha G.
review-10.title: Five litres is a real saver
review-10.body: I bought the 500 ml floor cleaner, loved it, and now refill from the 5-litre can. Works on marble and tiles without any residue.
